note: The two sets are nearly identical in content: both capture the 3/8" = 1'-0" scales for sections A1 and C1, the 2' - 9 1/2" finished floor and 0' - 0" grade datum, and the room contents of the Living Room and Centre Module sections. Both contain the same misread claim of 2' - 3 1/2" for the Living Room finished floor (the text layer and image both read 2' - 9 1/2"), the same vague 'CENTRE MODULE location K' and 'WEST MODULE location West' claims, and the same mislabeled 'Building Section A302' (A-302 is the sheet number). The only differences are trivial rewordings and one duplicated A1 scale claim in each set, so neither is more faithful than the other.
